original_query: What is the biggest reason why users sometimes choose not to use the applications, data of which are not mostly trusted by 8% users?

summaries.found_via_query: What is the primary reason users avoid applications whose data is not mostly trusted by 8% of users?
summaries.summary: The slide presents survey results from a 2014 Forrester Consulting study for SAP, showing that business users do not fully trust enterprise BI data. Of 171 business decision-makers surveyed, 24% trust all data fully, 67% trust data in some applications but not others, and 8% mostly do not trust data in enterprise BI applications. The chart visually represents these percentages with horizontal bars.
key_facts: 24% trust all enterprise BI data fully
67% trust data in some BI applications but not others
8% mostly do not trust data in enterprise BI applications
Survey base: 171 business decision-makers influencing BI decisions
Source: Forrester Consulting commissioned by SAP, March 2014
visible_text: Business Users Do Not Fully Trust Enterprise Data
How much do you trust data available in your enterprise BI applications?
Full trust in all data from all enterprise BI applications 24%
Trust data in some enterprise BI applications, not in others 67%
Mostly do not trust data in enterprise BI applications 8%
Base: 171 business decision-makers who influence BI decisions
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
